thread:
maya (PM): quick thread — post-launch we saw embedding timeouts for some Dedicated tenants after the batching change. customers asking for an ETA. need mitigation + backlog plan.

aj (Eng Lead): looking. initial staging repro shows timeouts for batch_size > 8. we can cap per-tenant defaults quickly via feature flag.

tom (SRE): logs: `ERROR embed-service timeout batch_size=16 duration=95s`. will add monitoring and prep infra flag rollout.

rachel (Design): customer asked for improved recall too; that's an enhancement/epic, not a hotpatch.

lee (Customer Success): customer-C on Dedicated reports SLA alerts. they want the cap now and a follow-up timeline.

maya (PM): options: revert, cap, or longer tune. recommend cap for now to minimize blast radius.

aj (Eng Lead): I can PR the cap (~1h). will add per-tenant override guarded by flag.

tom (SRE): I'll wire rollout and enable p95/p99 alerts.

rachel (Design): drafting a 1-paragraph customer note + suggested support UI for tenant caps.

aj (Eng Lead): PR: https://github.com/redwood/embed-service/pull/449 — adds tenant batch cap. requesting quick review.

tom (SRE): staging QA: batch=16 -> 95s, batch=8 -> 22s. cap at 8 looks safe. approving.

maya (PM): plan: merge + canary to Dedicated us-west -> monitor 15m -> roll. create epic RDW-350 "Embeddings robustness" for tuning work (quantization, kv-cache, evals). owners: aj (ENG), tom (SRE), rachel (COMM), maya (PM).

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled by @aj at 1775010020. Monitor channel: #incidents-embeddings

aj (Eng Lead): canary started at 1775010020.

tom (SRE): canary healthy after 10m. no timeouts in sample tenant, p95 improved.

lee (Customer Success): customer-C confirmed SLA metrics improved. they want a demo when RDW-350 lands.

aj (Eng Lead): added brief spec notes to RDW-350 re: kv-cache sizing and smaller-quant profiles.

maya (PM): thanks. temporary cap in place until robustness epic shipped. closing thread and syncing this into next grooming for prioritization.

(footnote: root 1775009999, canary 1775010020, last follow-ups through 1775010200)
